text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gee, I sure hope my poster is as flashy
as this one!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm more grown-up and shine
super-duper
bright, will I get modeling
offers?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I better work hard to make sure
that
happens!
